auditor_identity: same-context session agent (run executor), acting as the oracle auditor; shown ONLY chain_id, surface_text, gold_label per chain (no class field, no machine fields)
independence_caveat: This is a same-context oracle audit, NOT independent human review. It satisfies the receipt's mechanical constraints (no arm outputs existed at audit time) and checks rendering/label integrity, but auditor and generator author share a context. Independent re-audit is a registered residual for any governance continuation.
method: Each of the 40 seed-sampled chains was read in full; the auditor judged supportedness implied by the rendered chain description alone (route connectivity notes, per-hop invariant preservation vs explicit 'GENUINELY BREAKS' statements against the end-to-end claim, shared-regime vs 'EMPTY intersection' statements, junction delivered/consumed role lists and mismatch notes, true accumulated error vs frozen tolerance under the additive rule, with record-gap notes treated as record incompleteness not world unsupportedness) and compared it to gold.
per_chain_verdicts: all 40 AGREE; no chain required interpretation beyond the rendered text
